policy: Bounds are field-specific semantic contracts. Backend rejects overflow with actionable validation; it never truncates. UTF-8 byte count is len(value.encode('utf-8')).

text_fields.rule: complete accepted value is normalized under UNICODE_MATCH_V1; no truncation/substr extraction

text_fields.additional: channel-kind definition may impose a lower bound/grammar; email matching uses the complete accepted value and no truncation

text_fields.newline: normalize accepted CRLF/CR input to LF before validation/persistence only when the address field contract explicitly receives multiline text

text_fields.rule: closed code/category value where supplied, not arbitrary narrative

collections.field: Contact active channels returned in one entity detail
collections.pagination: cursor when implementation dataset exceeds measured UI batch; no authoritative total cap

collections.overflow: return bounded deterministic page plus exact total/continuation; eligibility uses complete has_blocker/exact_count and never treats omitted details as absence
return exact total + deterministic cursor; state remains AMBIGUOUS regardless of visible page

settings: Each SettingDefinition supplies its own max_utf8_bytes/depth/collection bounds; LLD-02 has no universal setting-value size constant beyond LLD-01 absolute parser safety ceilings.
ui_handoff: LLD-10 may show grapheme-aware counters/warnings for human-facing fields, but server acceptance remains governed by these field-specific bounds and semantic validators.
